summary: Backend testing for Cible CV API: 15/15 pytest tests passed against the external preview URL. Verified health, URL/PDF parsing, full Claude Sonnet 4.5 generation flow (cv/letter/adaptations + MongoDB persistence with uuid id), and full CRUD on /api/generations (list, get, put, delete) including 404 paths and empty-patch 400.

minor.issue: https://example.com body is barely above the 80-char minimum; returns 400 'Contenu insuffisant' depending on parsing. Tested fallback URL works. Consider lowering threshold or returning the raw text regardless for trivial pages.
Listing pops 'adaptations' and only surfaces match_score; loses position/company keywords. Functional, but UI may want keywords_matched count too.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses synchronous requests.get inside fetch_url_text called from an async endpoint - blocks the event loop. Recommend httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.
extract_pdf_text / extract_docx_text also sync; fine for small files but should run in a threadpool for large uploads.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
load_dotenv at import time + os.environ[...] direct access - fails fast (good), but no validation that EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is set until first /generate call (returns 500 instead of failing at startup).
No file-size limit on /parse/pdf - potential DoS via large uploads.
No rate limiting on /generate which calls a paid LLM - cost risk.
GenerationUpdate.profile_text/job_text not allowed for update - intentional? Consider if regenerate needs new inputs.
_extract_json is robust for fenced/plain JSON but won't handle nested code fences edge cases - acceptable.
test_credentials: n/a - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests create one generation via /api/generate and delete it at the end; no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend external URL: https://cv-matcher-41.preview.emergentagent.com/api. All 15 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_ciblecv.py pass. /generate takes ~25-30s with Claude Sonnet 4.5; use 120s timeout. PDF tests rely on reportlab (installed). Frontend was intentionally skipped.
